reserveReview.rationale: Anchorage's May 31 examination reports $240,981,509 of money market funds, $82,231,670 of BUIDL, and $1,613,956 of cash against $324,827,135 of reserve assets. The exact normalized weights are 74.18761643789395%, 25.31551743668213%, and 0.4968661254239206%; BUIDL is the only tracked canonical dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Anchorage examination of the USDGO Reserve Report as of May 31, 2026

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report says reserve assets are held in segregated fiduciary trust accounts for token holders and identifies Anchorage as the issuer and qualified custodian. It does not state a general rehypothecation prohibition. It also does not name the FDIC-insured banks holding the $1.6M cash slice or any money-market-fund subcustodian; the issuer transparency page (accessed 2026-07-17) identifies the two money market funds as the Goldman Sachs Stablecoin Reserves Fund and the JPMorgan OnChain Liquidity-Token Money Market Fund, but their underlying fund custodians remain undisclosed. Anchorage self-custodies the BUIDL slice in segregated wallets (Avalanche 0xC1d56E817d8f6C53D42eD50Ed0D789eEb1495b5e per the May 31, 2026 report).
